_about: Curated CORDIS DET queries for European Innovation Council (EIC) call subjects, keyed by the subject the tagger looks up (Call.topic_title where present, else the call title / Call.name). Subjects auto-extracted verbatim from the work-programme JSON, queries AI-authored + adversarially verified in the contenttype=project phrase-quoted style of cluster_1.json/cluster_3.json. CORDIS indexes EU RESEARCH projects (FP1-Horizon Europe); for non-research calls (and broad funding instruments such as ERC/MSCA) these find thematically related research, so a call's tags are the research fields of related funded projects, NOT its official scope. Re-run POST /cordis/tag-calls {"source":"eic"} to apply.

queries.Accelerating Physical AI: Embodied Intel: contenttype=project AND ("physical AI" OR "embodied intelligence" OR "embodied AI" OR "artificial intelligence") AND ("robotics" OR "autonomous robots" OR "intelligent robots" OR "human-robot interaction")
queries.EIC Accelerator 2026 - Short proposal: contenttype=project AND ("deep tech" OR "breakthrough innovation" OR "disruptive innovation") AND ("startups" OR "SMEs" OR "scale-up" OR "commercialisation")
queries.EIC STEP Scale Up: contenttype=project AND ("strategic technologies" OR "critical technologies" OR "deep tech") AND ("scale-up" OR "industrial scale-up" OR "technology sovereignty" OR "manufacturing")
queries.HORIZON-EIC-2026-BAS-01-ECOSYSTEM: contenttype=project AND ("innovation ecosystem" OR "innovation ecosystems" OR "startup ecosystem") AND ("deep tech" OR "entrepreneurship" OR "technology transfer" OR "capacity building")
queries.Translating Disruptive New Approach Meth: contenttype=project AND ("new approach methodologies" OR "NAMs" OR "non-animal methods" OR "alternatives to animal testing") AND ("toxicology" OR "in vitro" OR "organ-on-chip" OR "predictive toxicology")
